subject: 404 error on the installation manual of shiny-server for init.d config

messages.author: 4753f061948056b3
messages.subject: 404 error on the installation manual of shiny-server for init.d config
parts:
Hi,

On the page https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Building-Shiny-Server-from-Source , at the end of the page there is a link behond the here of "We provide some init.d scripts here" witch drove me to an 404 error.

Does it supposed to be https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/master/config/init.d/debian/shiny-server ?

By the way, as mentioned here https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/init.d$20debian/shiny-discuss/djU_sue5RxU/80mvA_CO2bgJ you may have to change  DAEMON=shiny-server in DAEMON=/usr/bin/shiny-server .

Cheers,

Grégoire
